newsitem.title: UK: Hambros adds 25 mln stg to Haven Funding 2037 bond.
newsitem.headline: Hambros adds 25 mln stg to Haven Funding 2037 bond.

text.p: Hambros Bank said on Wednesday that it is launching a 25 million stg tranche fungible with the Haven Funding 82.5 million stg bond due September 2037.
The new tranche has been bought by Hambros Bank and the proceeds will be onlent by Haven to Metropolitan Housing Trust Ltd.
The bonds will be placed at a spread of 105 basis points over the 8.0 pct 2021 gilt plus 105 days accrued interest.
